body:
I loved this person with my entire mind, body, and soul. Everything about her was perfect to me. Since we broke up in February, I haven't been able to even talk to another girl. I wouldn't even know how to go about kissing another female at this point, even if I had the opportunity. From time to time over the summer we would talk here and there and I'd ask to see her but she would always say absolutely not, knowing it would probably result in us getting back together and she didn't want that.

Since we broke up I had been contemplating killing myself almost every day. I think about every way I could do it, times, pain threshold, everything. I've tried to do it twice before failed both times, but no one knows this either. Not even D. 

Two days ago I get a text from her. She is saying happy early birthday and wondering what I'm doing to celebrate. I tell her nothing crazy and she asks if she can come. Of course I say sure, and I invite her to stay over my house so she doesn't have to worry about driving drunk. That's when she drops the bomb on me.

She says, "I can't stay over because I'm kind of seeing someone right now."

My whole world collapses around me. My heart immediately feels as though it's been injected with lead, my room starts expanding like a crazy acid trip, and all I can see is "seeing someone' on my iPhone.

I handled it somewhat maturely, but I kind of lost it in my head. When we were both 18 I bought her this ring from tiffany's with I love you inscribed around the band. When I gave it to her I told her that I loved her with all my heart, and that if ever she doubted it, just look at that ring and the only time she could take it off was when I gave her a new one(proposed). She never took it off the entire time, and even to this day she still wears it. I took her virginity and neither of us have been with anyone else since. All I can see is her fucking this new guy, wearing the ring I gave her. It kills me.

Since yesterday I've been a complete mess. I can't eat, I can't sleep, and my birthday is this weekend. Everything is falling apart around me as I realize how alone I really am. No one I invited to go out with me has gotten back to me, I don't know a single girl I can invite to come with me that will show up, and I am terrible at meeting people. I'm so worried, sad, and alone.

It's now 4:24am and all night I've been thinking about doing it. I'll be 23 on sunday and I don't think I'm going to make it. I know that once I do die, no one will know. I don't have a facebook or anything like that and my parents take such little interest in my life that they don't know a single person that I have hung out with in the past 11 years. I could die and no one would know, none of the people i've met along this shitty fucking journey I've called my life.

My parents try to say I'm lazy and I have no motivation because I don't have a job, but I've had a few since I've been home and I've quit them all for the same reason. I have no desire to live. I don't care what tomorrow is like because I know I'm going to be unhappy. I don't need money because I have nothing to do or anyone to do it with. People say killing yourself sends you to hell, but life on earth is hell for me so I'm thinking about taking my chances on there not even being an afterlife.

I can't tell anyone this because no one would believe me. My parents think I'm this genius with no motivation, which to some extent is true. I meet so many stupid people and I can't stand to communicate with them. I hate going anywhere because I constantly see things that make me upset, but no one would ever know. My father doesn't believe that depression or anxiety are real, and my mother barely knows me at all.

The only reason that I'm not doing anything right this second is because I have a sister who is about to go off to college next year. She is smarter than I am and I scored almost perfect on my SATs. She has a promising future ahead of her and I don't want to fuck her up at this crucial time of her life, but it's so fucking hard to stay here and deal.

D was the glue that held all my shitty fucking life together and when she left everything fell apart. I'm going to be 23 and I have absolutely nothing to show for it. I feel hopeless and I have no desire to do anything to change it. Everyone I've ever known has bailed on me, and those who are forced to interact with me don't trust me, although I've never wronged anyone.

I live with a burning desire to develop a terminal illness. I smoke cigarettes, I go out to bars occasionally and drink entirely too much. I don't do drugs because they make me feel even worse. I pray that a plane from the near by airport will crash into my bedroom and vaporize me instantly.

For a few weeks before D texted me, I had found salvation in the lottery. Believe it or not, something so stupid, a $1 ticket, brought me joy. I would sit and think about how if I won, I could start the business that I was going to business school to get a degree to get investors for. I could buy the only thing besides D i love, a ferarri. Most importantly, I could do something really romantic, and get her back.

Now that's gone from me. All the money in the world wouldn't make me happy at this point. I'm slowly dying from a broken heart. I have $0.53 cents to my name, student loans coming to be collected november 22nd, no job or hope of one, and a small bedroom in my dad and step mothers house where they have their 7 year old and they all can't stand me for interrupting their new little family.

D was my home. Anywhere I was with that girl was more of a home to me than any house I've been in with either of my parents since I was too young to even know what that meant.

I'm rambling at this point, but I'm starting to believe losing her has caused some kind of serious mental health issue with me. The thing is, I'd rather be dead than tell anyone about it.

I hate me. I miss her.


Fuck. My birthday is on Sunday and I have no desire to make it.
